开始页：新建、打开文件、示例。点“打开文件”，打开 WQ-LS 平缝机整机: Start page: new, open, examples. Click "Open" and open the WQ-LS lockstitch machine
最上面是菜单：文件、编辑、视图、工具……所有命令都在这里: At the top is the menu bar: File, Edit, View, Tools… every command is here
下面是工具栏：常用命令的按钮。鼠标停在按钮上会显示它是什么: Below it, the toolbars: buttons for common commands. Hover over a button to see what it does
工作台下拉框：零件设计、草图、装配、工程图、有限元……换工作台，工具栏跟着换: The workbench selector: Part Design, Sketcher, Assembly, TechDraw, FEM… switch workbench and the toolbars change
左上是模型树：文件里的每个对象。WQ-LS 按部件分了八组: Top left, the model tree: every object in the file. WQ-LS is grouped into eight assemblies
左下是属性：选中一个对象，它的位置、颜色、尺寸都在这里: Bottom left, the properties: select an object to see its placement, colour and dimensions
中间最大的是三维视图，零件在这里看、在这里点选: The big area in the middle is the 3D view, where you look at and pick parts
右上角是导航立方体：点它的面，就转到那个方向看: Top right, the navigation cube: click a face to look from that direction
报告视图：软件的提示、警告、出错都写在这里（视图 → 面板 → 报告视图）: Report view: messages, warnings and errors appear here (View → Panels → Report view)
最下面是状态栏：鼠标指着什么、当前的导航方式、单位: At the bottom, the status bar: what the mouse is over, the navigation style, the units
这就是 FreeCAD 的界面。问渠 CAD 是在它上面改的，界面一样: That is the FreeCAD interface. WenQuest CAD is built on it, so it looks the same
状态栏右下角写着“CAD”：现在是 CAD 导航方式（问渠 CAD 默认）: The status bar shows "CAD": the CAD navigation style (the WenQuest CAD default)
CAD 导航方式：按住中键拖动 = 平移: CAD navigation: hold the middle button and drag = pan
按住中键再按左键拖动 = 旋转: Hold the middle button, then the left button, and drag = rotate
滚轮 = 缩放：往前滚放大，往后滚缩小（以鼠标所在点为中心）: Wheel = zoom: forward to zoom in, back to zoom out (around the mouse position)
转乱了不要紧：点“适应全部”，整机回到画面中间: Lost the view? Click "Fit all" and the whole machine comes back to the centre
导航立方体：点“前视图”那一面，就从前面看；点角上，看轴测: Navigation cube: click the Front face to look from the front; click a corner for an isometric view
键盘也行：0 轴测、1 前、2 上、3 右: Or use the keyboard: 0 isometric, 1 front, 2 top, 3 right
左键点一个零件：它变绿，左下的属性里显示它的数据；点空白处取消: Left-click a part: it turns green and its data shows in the properties; click empty space to deselect
菜单“编辑 → 首选项”：软件的各种设置都在这里: Menu Edit → Preferences: all the settings are here
“常规”页的“语言和数字格式”：界面语言、默认单位系统（标准 mm / kg /: General → Language and number format: interface language, unit system (Standard mm / kg / s, or imperial), decimals
“显示 → 导航栏”：导航方式（CAD、Blender、触摸板……）也可以在这里: Display → Navigation: change the navigation style here (CAD, Blender, Touchpad…)
看完按“取消”，什么都不改: Click Cancel to leave without changing anything
从开始页新建一个“参数实体”：零件设计工作台，一个实体（Body）: From the start page create a "Parametric Body": Part Design workbench with one Body
点“新建草图”，选 XY 平面: Click "Create sketch" and choose the XY plane
圆工具：先点圆心（原点），再键入直径 16，回车: Circle tool: click the centre (the origin), type diameter 16, press Enter
工具还开着，接着画内孔：圆心还是原点，直径 8: The tool is still active: draw the bore, centre at the origin again, diameter 8
右边显示“完全约束”（绿色）：两个圆的位置、大小都定了: The panel says "Fully constrained" (green): both circles are fixed in place and size
关闭草图，选中草图点“凸台”，长度键入 3 mm: Close the sketch, select it, click "Pad" and type a length of 3 mm
压脚杆套环：外径 16、内孔 8、厚 3——和 WQ-LS 设计里的一样: Presser-bar collar: OD 16, bore 8, 3 thick — the same as in the WQ-LS design
针夹的轮廓：上面一段圆弧，下面一个方耳朵。先用“多段线”画三条直边: Needle-clamp outline: an arc on top, a square tab below. First draw three straight edges with Polyline
右键结束多段线（工具还开着就按 Esc 退出）: Right-click to finish the polyline (press Esc to leave the tool)
圆弧工具：先点圆心（原点），再点起点，绕过上面，到终点: Arc tool: click the centre (origin), then the start point, go round over the top to the end point
中间的孔：圆工具，圆心在原点，直径 8: The bore: Circle tool, centre at the origin, diameter 8
再画一条竖的中心线，切换成“构造线”（蓝色虚线：只帮忙定位，不成形）: Draw a vertical centre line and toggle it to construction (blue dashed: for positioning only, not part of the shape)
轮廓画好了，但尺寸是点出来的，不准——右边写着还有几个自由度。第 4 课用约束把: The outline is drawn, but by clicking, so the sizes are not exact — the panel still shows degrees of freedom. Lesson 4 fixes it with constraints
右边写着“约束不足”：还有几个自由度——形状能被拖动，尺寸没定: The panel says "Under-constrained": some degrees of freedom are left — the shape can be dragged, sizes are not fixed
拖一下下边线：整条边跟着走，因为它离原点多远还没定: Drag the bottom edge: the whole edge moves, because its distance from the origin is not fixed
圆弧也能拖大拖小：半径也没定: The arc can be dragged bigger or smaller: its radius is not fixed either
颜色也告诉你：白色是还能动的，完全约束以后全变绿: The colours tell you too: white can still move; when fully constrained everything turns green
几何约束：先选对象，再点约束按钮。中心线下端还没定——选它的下端点，再选下边线: Geometric constraints: select first, then click the constraint. The centre line's lower end is free — pick that end point, then the bottom edge
点“重合 / 点在线上”：端点落到线上: Click "Coincident / point on object": the end point snaps onto the edge
上端点放到圆弧上：同样先选，再点: Put the upper end point on the arc: again, select first, then click
左右对称：选左下角、右下角，再选竖轴（Y 轴），点“对称”: Symmetry: pick the lower-left and lower-right corners, then the vertical (Y) axis, and click "Symmetric"
红字“冗余约束”：对称已经让左右两点一样高，下边线原来的“水平”就重复了: Red text "Redundant constraints": symmetry already makes the two corners level, so the bottom edge's "Horizontal" says the same thing again
撤销对称（Ctrl+Z），在约束列表里选中那个“水平”，按 Delete 删掉: Undo the symmetry (Ctrl+Z), select that "Horizontal" in the constraint list and press Delete
再加对称：左下角、右下角、Y 轴，点“对称”: Add the symmetry again: lower-left corner, lower-right corner, Y axis, "Symmetric"
每加一个约束，自由度就少一点。剩下的要用尺寸定: Each constraint removes some freedom. The rest is fixed with dimensions
还剩 3 个自由度：圆弧多大、耳朵多宽、耳朵伸多长。用尺寸约束定: 3 degrees of freedom left: arc size, tab width, tab length. Fix them with dimensions
选下边线，点“水平距离”，键入 7（耳朵宽 7）: Select the bottom edge, click "Horizontal distance", type 7 (tab width 7)
选原点和下边线，点“距离”，键入 7（下边离中心 7）: Select the origin and the bottom edge, click "Distance", type 7 (bottom edge 7 from the centre)
“完全约束”，整个草图变绿：每条线在哪、多大都定了: "Fully constrained" — the whole sketch turns green: every line's position and size is fixed
关闭草图，凸台 8 mm：针夹就出来了（尺寸和 WQ-LS 设计里的针夹一样）: Close the sketch and pad 8 mm: there is the needle clamp (same sizes as the WQ-LS design)
点“新建草图”，选 XZ 平面: Click "Create sketch" and choose the XZ plane
点“新建草图”，选 YZ 平面: Click "Create sketch" and choose the YZ plane
打开上一课存的针夹草图，在模型树里双击草图，进入编辑: Open the needle-clamp sketch saved in the last lesson and double-click the sketch in the model tree to edit it
打开 WQ-LS 整机，这一段练鼠标：平移、旋转、缩放，再看标准视图、选零件: Open the WQ-LS machine. This clip practises the mouse: pan, rotate, zoom, then standard views and selecting parts
开始页点“空文件”：新建一个空文档: On the start page click "Empty File": a new empty document
工作台换成“零件”（Part）：它有现成的立方体、圆柱这些基本体: Switch to the Part workbench: it has ready-made primitives such as the cube and cylinder
点“立方体”：10 × 10 × 10 的方块出现在原点；模型树里多了一项: Click "Cube": a 10 × 10 × 10 block appears at the origin, and the model tree gets a new item
撤销（Ctrl+Z 或工具栏的弯箭头）：圆柱没了: Undo (Ctrl+Z or the curved arrow): the cylinder is gone
重做（Ctrl+Y）：圆柱又回来了。撤销可以一步步往回退很多步: Redo (Ctrl+Y): the cylinder is back. Undo can step back many steps
保存（Ctrl+S）：第一次保存要起名字，文件扩展名是 .FCStd: Save (Ctrl+S): the first time you give it a name; the extension is .FCStd
窗口下面的标签页显示了文件名。以后再按 Ctrl+S 就直接存，不再问: The tab below the view now shows the file name. From now on Ctrl+S saves without asking
打开上一段存的“练习”。在模型树里先点立方体，再按住 Ctrl 点圆柱：两个都选: Open the "practice" file from the last clip. In the tree click the cube, then Ctrl-click the cylinder: both are selected
点“剪切”：从立方体里挖掉圆柱。模型树里，立方体和圆柱收进了“剪切”下面——剪切: Click "Cut": the cylinder is removed from the cube. In the tree the cube and cylinder move under "Cut" — the cut depends on them
改圆柱：在模型树里点圆柱，在属性里把半径改成 3: Change the cylinder: click it in the tree and set its Radius to 3 in the properties
再把位置改到方块中间：x = 5，y = 5: Then move it to the middle of the block: x = 5, y = 5
剪切的结果跟着变了：一个穿通的孔。这就是参数化——改前面的对象，后面依赖它的全部: The cut follows: now a through hole. That is parametric design — change an earlier object and everything that depends on it is recomputed
别人要你的零件，又不用 FreeCAD：导出成 STEP，几乎所有 CAD 都能: Someone needs your part but does not use FreeCAD: export STEP, which almost every CAD program opens. First select the needle bar in the tree
菜单“文件 → 导出”，文件类型选 STEP，起名“针杆”，保存: Menu File → Export, choose the STEP file type, name it "needle_bar", Save
导出好了。检查一下：新建空文档，“文件 → 导入”刚才的 STEP: Exported. Check it: new empty document, File → Import the STEP file
针杆完整回来了，体积和原来一样。STL（三维打印用）、DXF（二维图）也在“导出: The needle bar comes back complete, with the same volume. STL (3D printing) and DXF (2D drawings) are under Export too and work the same way
曲柄的轮廓：下面是套在主轴上的大圆（直径 33），上面是装曲柄销的小圆（直径 2: The crank outline: a large circle on the main shaft (diameter 33) below, a small circle for the crank pin (diameter 22) above, 15.5 apart
右边画一条线，两头分别点在两个圆上: On the right draw a line with one end on each circle
加“相切”：选线、选大圆，点相切；再选线、选小圆，点相切: Add Tangent: select the line and the large circle, click Tangent; then the line and the small circle, Tangent
左边不用再画：选中这条线，点“对称”工具，再点竖轴（Y 轴）——镜像出左边的线: No need to draw the left side: select the line, click the Symmetry tool, then click the vertical (Y) axis — it mirrors the line
修剪：点“修剪”工具，再一段段点掉圆上不要的部分——大圆上面三段、小圆下面一段: Trim: click the Trim tool, then click away the unwanted parts of the circles one by one — three on top of the large circle, one at the bottom of the small one
左边那条线是镜像出来的，修剪把它的两头接上了圆弧，但还没“相切”：照右边一样，选: The left line came from the mirror; the trims joined its ends to the arcs, but it is not tangent yet: as on the right, select the line and an arc, click Tangent — twice
轮廓出来了：大圆弧、两条切线、小圆弧连成一圈。还剩 1 个自由度：两个圆心的距离: There is the outline: large arc, two tangent lines and small arc in one loop. One degree of freedom is left — the distance between the centres; the next clip sets it from a spreadsheet
上一段的曲柄草图还差中心距。这次不直接写 15.5，而是写进电子表格，让草图去读: The crank sketch still needs the centre distance. Instead of typing 15.5 into the sketch, put it in a spreadsheet and let the sketch read it — later you just change the sheet
模型树里多了 Spreadsheet，双击打开：A1 写名字，B1 写 15.5: A Spreadsheet appears in the model tree. Double-click it: a name in A1, 15.5 in B1
回到模型，双击草图进入编辑: Back to the model; double-click the sketch to edit it
选原点和小圆的圆心，点“竖直距离”。弹出的框里先打等号，再写 Spreadshe: Select the origin and the small circle's centre, click "Vertical distance". In the box type an equals sign, then Spreadsheet.B1, Enter
尺寸前面多了个“f(x)”标记：它是算出来的，不是手填的。草图完全约束了: The dimension now shows an f(x) mark: it is computed, not typed. The sketch is fully constrained
关闭草图，凸台 10 mm，曲柄的板就出来了: Close the sketch and pad 10 mm: there is the crank plate
现在改表：B1 改成 18，重新计算，曲柄跟着变长: Now change the sheet: set B1 to 18, recompute, and the crank gets longer
一张表管住一组尺寸：做系列零件、把计算结果直接带进模型，都靠它: One sheet controls a set of dimensions: that is how you make part families and bring calculation results straight into the model
针杆是一根细长的圆杆：直径 8、长 180。回转体不用一层层拉伸，画半个截面，绕: The needle bar is a long thin rod: diameter 8, length 180. For a turned part, don't pad it layer by layer: sketch half the section and revolve it
XZ 平面上画半截面：从原点起一个矩形，宽 4（半径）、高 180: On the XZ plane, draw the half section: a rectangle from the origin, 4 wide (the radius) and 180 high
矩形左边贴着竖轴——待会儿就绕这根轴转: Its left edge lies on the vertical axis—that is the axis we will revolve around
点“旋转”：轴默认是“垂直草绘轴”，角度 360°，确定: Click Revolution: the default axis is the vertical sketch axis, angle 360°. OK
A plain rod, diameter 8. Now the oil groove: 39.25 mm from the bottom end, 0.5 wide, 0.2 deep
放大到杆的右边缘，画一个小矩形：宽 0.2、高 0.5: Zoom in on the right edge of the rod and draw a small rectangle: 0.2 wide, 0.5 high
矩形的位置用尺寸锁住：选左下角，“水平距离”3.8；再选它，“竖直距离”39.2: Lock its position with dimensions: pick the lower-left corner, Horizontal distance 3.8; pick it again, Vertical distance 39.25
完全约束了。关闭草图，点“挖槽旋转”：同样绕竖轴 360°: Fully constrained. Close the sketch and click Groove: again 360° around the vertical axis
一圈油槽出来了。旋转、挖槽旋转是“凸台、凹槽”的回转版：一个加材料，一个去材料: There is the groove. Revolution and Groove are the turned versions of Pad and Pocket: one adds material, the other removes it
曲柄销：直径 10、长 25 的圆柱，一头有 M3 螺纹孔，装在曲柄上: The crank pin: a cylinder 10 in diameter and 25 long, with an M3 threaded hole in one end; it fits into the crank
圆心在原点、直径 10，完全约束。凸台 25 mm: Centre on the origin, diameter 10: fully constrained. Pad 25 mm
孔要有定位：点选上端面，新建草图，在原点放一个点: A hole needs a position: click the top face, create a sketch, and put a point on the origin
选中这个草图，点“孔”: Select that sketch and click Hole
螺纹类型选“ISO 米制普通螺纹”，规格 M3x0.5: Thread type: ISO metric regular profile, size M3x0.5
孔的类型选第二项“攻丝钻”：先钻底孔、以后攻丝，不画螺纹线: Hole type: the second item, the tap drill—drill now, tap later, no thread geometry
深度 7.5；去掉“钻孔角度”，孔底是平的: Depth 7.5; untick the drill point angle so the bottom is flat
孔是螺纹孔，但默认不画螺纹线：按底孔直径 2.5 挖，属性里记着“M3”——出工: It is a threaded hole, but the thread isn't modelled: it is cut at the tap-drill size 2.5 and remembers "M3"—drawings label the thread automatically
凸台加材料，凹槽去材料；孔是专门的“凹槽”：螺纹、沉头、钻尖都能直接选: Pad adds material, Pocket removes it; Hole is a specialised pocket: threads, counterbores and drill points are all options
接着上一课的针杆，两圈油槽都做好了。真针杆两头还各有 0.5 的倒角：装进轴套不: The needle bar from the last lesson, with both oil grooves. The real bar also has a 0.5 chamfer at each end, so it slides into its bushes without scraping
点选下端的圆边，按住 Ctrl 再点上端的圆边: Click the circular edge at the bottom, then hold Ctrl and click the edge at the top
体积 9036.86 mm³：和整机 STEP 里的真针杆一样——尺寸、油槽、倒: Volume 9036.86 mm³: the same as the real needle bar in the machine STEP—sizes, grooves and chamfers all match
圆角也是这样：选边，点“圆角”，填半径。倒角、圆角都是“修饰特征”，加在零件做好: Fillets work the same way: pick edges, click Fillet, enter a radius. Chamfers and fillets are dress-up features, added once the part is built
梭壳（装梭芯的小杯子）：外径 22.4、深 14、壁厚 0.6。杯子、盒子、外壳: The bobbin case, a small cup that holds the bobbin: 22.4 outside, 14 deep, 0.6 wall. Cups, boxes and covers are made with Thickness
点选上端面——开口就开在这一面: Click the top face—this is where the opening goes
点“抽壳”，厚度 0.6，确定：选中的面被挖开，其余的面都留 0.6 的壁: Click Thickness, 0.6, OK: the selected face is opened and every other face keeps a 0.6 wall
杯子出来了，体积约 787 mm³。真梭壳的底厚 1.5：抽壳只能处处一样厚，底: There's the cup, about 787 mm³. The real bobbin case has a 1.5 bottom: Thickness is the same everywhere, so for a thicker bottom pocket the cavity instead (see On your own)
弹簧是螺旋：一个圆（钢丝的截面）绕着轴边转边往上走。压脚簧：外径 15.8、钢丝: A spring is a helix: a circle (the wire section) turns around an axis while climbing. The presser spring: 15.8 outside, wire 1.8
On the XZ plane, draw the wire section: centre on the horizontal axis, 7 from the origin (half the mean diameter), diameter 1.8
圆心的位置用“水平距离”锁住：7: Lock the centre with Horizontal distance: 7
点“螺旋”：轴选“垂直草绘轴”，节距 4、高度 60: Click Additive helix: axis Vertical sketch axis, pitch 4, height 60
15 圈的弹簧。改节距、圈数、高度，弹簧跟着变；左旋弹簧勾“左旋”: A 15-turn spring. Change pitch, turns or height and the spring follows; tick Left handed for a left-hand coil
A sweep moves a section along a path. The check spring is a 0.7 wire bent into an R9.35 arc with a straight leg
先画路径。圆弧：圆心点原点，起点点在横轴上，绕一大圈到右下方: First the path. Arc: centre on the origin, start on the horizontal axis, then sweep round to the lower right
从圆弧的终点画一条直线，大致顺着圆弧的方向: From the end of the arc, draw a line roughly continuing its direction
加约束：圆弧半径 9.35、圆心角 265°；直线和圆弧相切，长 14.85: Constraints: arc radius 9.35, angle 265°; line tangent to the arc, length 14.85
路径完全约束了。关闭草图: The path is fully constrained. Close the sketch
再画截面：XZ 平面，圆心在圆弧的起点（横轴上、离原点 9.35）；放大，加直径: Now the section on the XZ plane: centre at the start of the arc (on the horizontal axis, 9.35 out); zoom in, add diameter 0.7 and horizontal distance 9.35
选中截面草图，点“添加式管道”；在面板里点路径旁的“对象”，再到视图里点一下路径: Select the section sketch, click Additive pipe; in the panel click Object next to the path, then click the path in the view
钢丝沿着路径弯出来了。路径和截面分开画：改路径，弹簧形状跟着变: The wire follows the path. Path and section are separate sketches: change the path and the spring follows
手轮：轮毂、薄腹板、外缘。毛坯用第 6 课的“旋转”做好了。腹板上要挖 5 个减: The handwheel: hub, thin web, rim. The blank was made with Revolution as in lesson 6. The web needs 5 lightening holes
画一个就够：XY 平面开草图，圆心点在竖轴上，直径 20；再锁住离中心 30: Draw just one: sketch on XY, centre on the vertical axis, diameter 20; then lock it 30 from the centre
凹槽：类型“通过所有”，勾“反转”——草图在手轮底面上，反转才是往里挖: Pocket: type Through all, tick Reversed—the sketch is on the bottom face, so reversed cuts into the part
选中这个凹槽，点“环形阵列”：轴默认是草图的法向（手轮的轴），次数 5，360°: Select the pocket and click Polar pattern: the axis defaults to the sketch normal (the wheel axis); 5 occurrences over 360°
5 个孔一圈均布。改次数，孔数跟着变；改原来那个孔，5 个一起变: Five holes evenly spaced. Change the count and the holes follow; change the original hole and all five change
